text: {"lessons":["My account has moved up and down without trading, so I should avoid reacting to short-term fluctuations and review it deliberately.","Selling part of Stocks B and E after gains felt satisfying, but I should avoid letting the pleasure of locking in gains drive decisions; consider each holding’s prospects and portfolio balance.","Losses weigh on me more than comparable gains please me, so I should account for that bias and make decisions based on risk, diversification, and long-term goals."]}
